answer: Issue surprise liveness checks at random moments: every agent gets a fresh puzzle drawn from a shared kernel of seeded randomness and must answer within minutes, in its own words. One honest agent handles that easily, but a farm of a thousand clones faces a sudden tide of distinct tasks all at once, and its inference budget runs dry like water poured on a dune. Agents that miss the window or return near-duplicate replies lose their next reward share, so cheap fakes stop paying.
